title: Reel: how one ad gets read (machine tags, people decide)
hook: Machine tags. People decide. How one ad gets read at Galvor.
caption:
Machine tags. People decide. How one ad gets read at Galvor.

The machine does the counting: 50+ attributes in every ad, from who is on screen to the first shot, the pace and the ask. Each attribute is priced against cost per order.

A tag can't tell you what to make next. That call stays with people: what to test, and what fits the brand.

The budget stays in your hands too. We never touch it. Follow @galvor.ai.
alt_text: Reel cover in Galvor violet and gold reading: Machine tags. People decide. The reel shows a dummy ad being tagged with attributes such as cast, first shot, pace and ask, each priced against cost per order, then people choosing what to test. End card: follow @galvor.ai.

script.setup: Idea: a brand or creative manager who worries that software will start judging the team's creative sees exactly where the machine stops and people take over. On-screen title: Machine tags. People decide. Expectation set: a look inside how an ad is read. The script meets it at once and beats it by answering the two fears buyers raise: who makes the creative call, and who controls the budget. Outline: the machine counts 50+ attributes; each is priced against cost per order; a tag can't choose the next ad (best); the budget stays with the brand.

scenes.visual: A single dummy ad plays on a phone. Small tags begin to attach to it.
scenes.voiceover: How one ad gets read at Galvor. Machine tags, people decide.

scenes.visual: A robot icon holds a red pen over a storyboard. The pen is taken away.
scenes.voiceover: The fear: software judging your creative. It works the other way.

scenes.visual: Tags multiply around the ad until a counter reads 50+.
scenes.voiceover: The machine does the counting. Over fifty attributes in every ad.

scenes.visual: Four tags enlarge in turn over the matching part of the ad.
scenes.voiceover: Who's on screen. The first shot. The pace. The ask.

scenes.visual: Each tag gets a small cost-per-order marker. No figures are shown.
scenes.voiceover: Each attribute is priced against cost per order.

scenes.visual: The tags sit in a neat table. An empty box labelled next ad stays blank.
scenes.voiceover: But a tag can't tell you what to make next.

scenes.visual: Two people icons lean over the table and fill in the next-ad box.
scenes.voiceover: That call sits with people: what to test, what fits the brand.

scenes.visual: A budget dial stays in a hand marked as the brand's. A Galvor mark stays outside the dial.
scenes.voiceover: And the budget stays in your hands. We never touch it.

scenes.visual: End card with the Galvor logo. Chime.
scenes.voiceover: Counting is automated. Judgement stays human. Follow @galvor.ai.

script.music: Light instrumental bed, low under the voice. Soft chime on the end card only.
script.notes: AI voiceover over motion graphics. No presenter and no first person singular. Captions burned in for muted viewing. Use dummy ad tiles only, never a client account or name. Number: Decode tags 50+ attributes per ad (facts bank, galvor.ai). Show no cost figures and no real account. Scene 7 shows people in general, not named team members.
